description: Get the profile of the current authenticated Figma user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the current user object (id, handle, email, img_url); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the projects belonging to a team.

team_id.description: The unique id of the team.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the team name and a list of project objects (id, name); on failure (team not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the files belonging to a project.

project_id.description: The unique id of the project.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the project name and a list of file objects (key, name, thumbnail_url, last_modified); on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single file, including its document node tree and components, by its file key.

file_key.description: The unique key of the file.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the file object (name, role, lastModified, editorType, thumbnailUrl, version, document, components); on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get specific nodes within a file's document tree by their ids.

file_key.description: The unique key of the file.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of node ids to retrieve.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the file name, lastModified, version, and a nodes map of requested node ids to node documents (or null when absent); on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the comments on a file.

file_key.description: The unique key of the file.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a list of comment views (id, file_key, message, client_meta, user, resolved_at, created_at); on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new comment on a file, optionally attached to a node.

file_key.description: The unique key of the file to comment on.

node_id.description: Optional node id to attach the comment to.

user_id.description: Optional user id of the comment author (defaults to 'user-1001').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created comment view; on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the published components in a file.

file_key.description: The unique key of the file.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a meta object with a list of components (key, file_key, node_id, name, description); on failure (file not found), output contains an error message.
